documents.label: A
documents.citation: Tennessee Valley Authority Act, Section 1, May 18, 1933 (National Archives, public domain)
documents.excerpt: Be it enacted...for the especial purpose of bringing about in said Tennessee Valley and adjoining territory...the maximum amount of flood control; the maximum development of said Tennessee River for navigation purposes; the maximum generation of electric power consistent with flood control and navigation; the proper use of marginal lands; the proper method of reforestation of all lands in said drainage basin suitable for reforestation; and the economic and social well-being of the people living in said river basin.

documents.label: B
documents.citation: FDR Message to Congress Recommending Establishment of the TVA, April 10, 1933 (FDR Presidential Library, public domain)
documents.excerpt: It is clear that the Muscle Shoals development is but a small part of the potential public usefulness of the entire Tennessee River...if we are careful and far-sighted, we can make it serve as a model for the whole nation... I suggest that this power development of war days be used not merely as an opportunity for the comfort and happiness of adjoining States but as a means of planning for the improvement of the broadest of physical, social, and economic conditions in the whole of the territory.

documents.label: C
documents.citation: Statement of Wendell Willkie, President of Commonwealth and Southern Corporation (private utility), opposing TVA expansion, Congressional testimony, 1933 (Congressional Record, public domain)
documents.excerpt: The Tennessee Valley Authority is entering into direct competition with established private industry which has made enormous investments in good faith under the laws of the land. The power business is not a natural monopoly...The government should not compete with private enterprise in the distribution of electric power. This is not a question of power rates; it is a question of whether the government of the United States is going to socialize the electric utility industry.
